Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TORCH, ALCOHOL, DENTAL 



1. Scope — Specifies the requirements of alcohol torch used in dentistry. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 




BURNER, 
OD 6-5, 
10 5-0

SCREW CAP

■BOTTLE 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 TORCH, ALCOHOL DENTAL 



2.1 Tolerances on various dimensions shall be permitted as given below: 

a) ± O'l mm on dimensions up to 10*0 mm, 

b) ± 0*2 mm on dimensions above lO'O mm and up to 200 mm, 

c) ± 0"5 mm on dimensions above 20*0 mm and up to 500 mm, and 

d) ± 20 mm on dimensions above 50'0 mm. 

3. Materials 

3.1 Bottle — Polyvinyl chloride sheet of thickness 10 d= 0'1 mm. 

Z.2 Burner ^Ihe burner shall be fabricated from brass conforming to Type I of IS : 319 - 1974 
'Specification for free-cutting brass bars, rods and sections ( third revision )'. 

3.3 Wicl<: — Cotton shall be used for fabrication of the wick. 

3.4 Air Pipe — Air pipe shall be made of brass conforming to Designation CuZn39Pba of IS : 531 -1 981 
'Specification for leaded brass strip for instruments ( second revision )'. 

3.5 Balls — Glass. 

3.6 Cap and Cover — Polyvinyl chloride. 

4. Construction 

4.1 The bottle sh^Il have a wick tube section, a cap, a cover and a burner fitted to it. The cap shall 
be such that it can be screwed on to the bottle.

4.2 All the metal components shall be coated with a uniform thickness of chromium over nickel 
conforming to Service Grade 2 of IS : 4827 - 1968 'Specification for electroplated coatings of nickel and 
chromium on copper and copper alloys', 

4.3 The bottle shall have eight glass bails, having a mass of 50 ± 0'5 gms each. 

4.4 The wick tube section shall be constructed such that the vertical axis is perpendicular to a horizon- 
tal plane. An air pipe shall be provided on one side of the assembly as shown in Fig. 1. 

4.5 The bottle shall be flexible enough to displace air through the air pipe and it shall not acquire a 
permanent set on being pressed. 

4.6 The cover fabricated from PVC shall be so constructed that its inside diameter makes a snug fit 
with the top end of the wick tube section. 

4.7 The core of the wick sha!! be fabricated from loosely twisted cotton yarns and the covering shall 
be of a loosely woven cotton fabric in the form of a seamless hollow tube, 

4.8 The torch shall be so constructed that there is no evidence of leakage. 

5. Capacity — The capacity of the torch shall be 105 ± 5 ml. 

Mote — The capacity shall be measured before the glass balls are introduced in the torch. 

6. Leakage Test — The bottle shall be filled with methyl or ethyl alcohol and allowed to stand for 30 
minutes, on a white blotting paper. Alcohol shall contain an alcohol soluble dye. The blotting paper 
shall show no sign of stain due to leakage. 

7. Marking — Each torch shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, address, 
country of manufacture and the directions for use. A mark shall also be provided on the torch to 
indicate the maximum level up to which alcohol shall be filled. 

7.1 /Sf Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — Each torch shall be wrapped in polyethylene bag and shall then be packed in a 
cardboard carton using sufficient packing material such as therm.ocole. 



Printed at Printrade, New Delhi, India
